We are happy to announce that Update 2.0 is now available for download! Enjoy the newly added destructible elements, survival mode and removal of the StarForce DRM.

20% OFF FOR A LIMITED TIME ONLY
To celebrate this occasion, we are offering VR Invaders at a special discount of 20% off the regular retail price. Make sure to make use of this limited time offer - only available until 5th of March 2017!

UPDATE 2.0 AVAILABLE
To find out more about the Update contents, please refer to our Update 2.0 announcement post

notes.title: Update 2.0 Live Now!
notes.content:
http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/07/1487324138-ezgif-com-d0f3baf2d9.gif

Greetings Divers!

It has been three months since the initial release of VR Invaders, and we are excited to finally announce the release of the VR Invaders Update 2.0 for Steam VR (HTC Vive and Oculus Rift).

The update will release on the 20th of February 2017 and will download automatically when you start the game for the next time after then.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27156172/bf6fb9608e3570439b64ec3b80bfaa1aeae5ce3f.png
UPDATE 2.0 CONTENTS

Removed StarForce DRMThe game can now be installed on as many machines as you would like.
Introduced destructible level elements. Blast through enemy cover and leave a trail of destruction as you progress through the game.
Added the “Survival” game mode. Fight against hordes of enemies and try to survive for as long as you can.
MiscellanousMade various small improvements to performance.


We hope you will have as much fun with this update as we had developing it!

- The VR Invaders Team
